remarks: Welcome to 124 Gregory Pl, a spacious and thoughtfully maintained 4-bedroom, 2.5-bath home in a very desirable Grand Island location! Beautiful curb appeal.  This inviting home offers hardwood floors throughout, including beneath carpeting, and an abundance of natural light. Lots of storage throughout the home. The comfortable family room features built-in bookshelves and a ventless gas fireplace, creating a warm and welcoming space for relaxing or entertaining. The kitchen offers ample cabinetry and workspace, with fridge, stove, dishwasher and garbage disposal included. Vaulted ceilings that open up the living room and formal dining room. The first-floor mudroom adds everyday convenience, while the bright Florida room addition—with baseboard heat and walls of windows—provides a wonderful additional living space overlooking the backyard. Upstairs, the generous primary bedroom features two closets and a remodeled private bath with a walk-in shower. A second bathroom includes a relaxing Jacuzzi tub. Three additional nice sized bedrooms.  The basement offers excellent storage and additional usable space. A refurbished boiler (2025) with three heating zones provides efficient, individually controlled comfort throughout the home. There is a junction box for the/an RV that is separate from the 125 amp electrical box in the basement. Other features include Anderson windows, ceiling fans, a whole-house fan, and a three-car-wide driveway and additional parking on the side of the house. Enjoy the outdoors in the large yard with a 12' x 12' shed and vegetable garden. Bike path located behind the property. The backyard also offers added privacy, Woods behind the property. A garage and additional storage complete this well-rounded property. A wonderful opportunity to own a spacious Grand Island home with flexible living areas, numerous updates, and plenty of storage. Piano included.  VIRTUALLY STAGED photos are included.  Offers will be reviewed as they come in.
